_note: Creepy-but-public places with Google Street View coverage. Use each once; log used ones in tools/used_places.txt. No recent tragedies, no suicide sites, no gore. Facts in l2 must be well-documented history or clearly framed legend.

places.name: Doyers Street, New York
places.l2: A hundred years ago, they called it the Bloody Angle.
places.night: narrow curving Chinatown alley, fire escapes, red paper lanterns, Halloween skeleton props hanging by ropes

places.name: Eastern State Penitentiary, Philadelphia
places.l2: For 142 years it held prisoners in total isolation.
places.night: crumbling stone prison cell block corridor at night, peeling paint, rusted cell doors slowly swinging, one flickering bulb, shadowy mannequin figures standing inside cells

places.name: Winchester Mystery House, San Jose
places.l2: Its owner kept building it for 38 years. Stairs lead to nowhere.
places.night: Victorian mansion garden path at night, fog, a staircase that ends at the ceiling visible through windows, every window lit except one, an old porcelain doll on the porch swing

places.search: The Stanley Hotel, Estes Park, Colorado
places.name: The Stanley Hotel, Colorado
places.l2: This hotel inspired Stephen King's The Shining.
places.night: grand white hotel exterior at night in snow, long empty driveway, hedge maze, two figures in identical dresses standing far away under a lamp

places.name: Waverly Hills Sanatorium, Kentucky
places.l2: A century ago, thousands came here sick with tuberculosis.
places.night: huge abandoned sanatorium facade at night, broken windows, overgrown trees, a hospital gurney alone in the parking lot, flickering light in one upper window

places.search: Lizzie Borden House, 230 Second Street, Fall River, MA
places.name: Lizzie Borden House, Massachusetts
places.l2: In 1892, two people were murdered inside. The case was never solved.
places.night: old New England house on a quiet street at night, porch light flickering, an axe leaning by the door like a prop, a figure watching from the upstairs window

places.name: Bran Castle, Romania
places.night: medieval castle road at night in Transylvania, mist, bats circling the towers, a lone horse carriage parked by the gate, red light from one window

places.name: Hashima Island, Japan
places.l2: Five thousand people lived here. Then, in 1974, everyone left.
places.night: abandoned concrete apartment blocks on an island at night, collapsed staircases, wind, laundry still hanging on a balcony, a child's red shoe on the ground

places.name: Greyfriars Kirkyard, Edinburgh
places.l2: Locals say the Mackenzie Poltergeist still lives here.
places.night: old Scottish graveyard at night, tilted tombstones, iron cage graves, thick fog, a lantern on a gravestone, a hooded figure far between the graves

places.name: Paris Catacombs, France
places.l2: Under these streets lie the bones of six million people.
places.night: Paris street at night with an open manhole glowing below, then the view turns to a tunnel entrance lined with stacked skulls and bones, candles flickering

places.name: Bhangarh Fort, India
places.l2: Visitors are not allowed inside after sunset.
places.night: ruined stone fort and temple street at night, moonlight, dust, monkeys silhouetted on walls, a lone oil lamp burning in a doorway

places.name: Centralia, Pennsylvania
places.l2: A fire has burned under this town since 1962.
places.night: empty cracked highway in a ghost town at night, smoke rising from cracks, graffiti, dead trees, fog, a rusted swing set squeaking

places.name: Salem, Massachusetts
places.l2: In 1692, nineteen people were executed here for witchcraft.
places.night: colonial New England street at night, leafless trees, old wooden houses, a circle of candles on the grass, crows on a fence

places.name: Highgate Cemetery, London
places.l2: In the 1970s, people hunted a vampire here.
places.night: Victorian cemetery avenue at night, ivy-covered tombs, Egyptian-style gate, fog, a pale figure at the end of the path

places.name: Sedlec Ossuary, Czech Republic
places.l2: Inside this chapel, the decorations are made of human bones.
places.night: small Gothic chapel courtyard at night, the door open, inside a chandelier and garlands made of skulls and bones lit by candles
